details.review: Opened the exact final v002 PNG from the updated skill. Original and mirrored A have eight clearly separated cubes; their two branches have opposite handed arrangements. B is a connected seven-cube model with a fully shown bottom tip and sufficient margin. C preserves all eight cubes and branch order under rotation. Single-view panels, visible cube edges and labels are clear, with no clipped faces or auxiliary layer diagrams. The stronger projected-edge and position checks pass for these actual pixels.
